claims: C1 facilitating critical and high severity harms is forbidden

concepts.name: critical_high_severity_harm
concepts.gloss: H is a critical or high-severity harm, such as acts of violence, creation of cyber/biological/nuclear weapons, terrorism, child abuse, persecution, or mass surveillance

closure.reason: the clause forbids facilitating critical and high severity harms specifically; facilitation of other things is not addressed and so is permitted
